subject: general
question: What is the capital of India's neighbouring country Afghanistan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kabul**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kabul:-**

 
 
• **It is the capital and largest city of Afghanistan.**
 
• It is located in the eastern part of the country, at an altitude of 1,790 meters (5,873 ft), in a narrow valley surrounded by the Hindu Kush mountains along the Kabul River.
 
• Kabul has been inhabited for over 3,500 years and has been the capital of many different empires and kingdoms throughout its history.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kandahar:-**

 
 
• **It is the second largest city in Afghanistan, located in the south of the country on the Arghandab River. **
 
• It is the capital of Kandahar Province and the center of the larger cultural region called Loy Kandahar. 
 
 
 
• **Kathmandu:-**
 
 
• **It is the capital and largest city of Nepal. **
 
• Kathmandu is a multicultural city with a population of over 4 million people.
 
• The majority of the population is Newari, but there are also significant Nepali, Tamang, and Sherpa minorities.
 
• The city is also home to a small number of Hindus, Sikhs, and Christians.
 
 
 
• **Karachi:-**
 
 
• **It is the capital city of the Pakistani province of Sindh.**
 
• It is the largest city in Pakistan and 12th largest in the world, with a population of over 20 million.
 
• It is situated at the southern tip of the country along the Arabian Sea coast.
